What it is

Single operator page tying SUPER-CENTAUR, monetary pipeline (MAP), and ecosystem CWPs to live p31ca URLs. Data health · MAP · mesh fleet · sovereignty is a core component of the P31 Labs sovereign cognitive infrastructure stack — built to run offline, deployed to the edge, and designed without dark patterns.

Verifier reads integration-handoff/CWP-30/mesh-bridge.ts and requires public/p31-super-centaur-pack.json meshFleet to match. Ring D deploy (phosphorus SUPER-CENTAUR) is out of scope for this static surface.

Single operator page tying SUPER-CENTAUR, monetary pipeline (MAP), and ecosystem CWPs to live p31ca URLs

How to use

1Open the starter page from the hub or /centaur — skim structural, data, and financial sections
2Use the JSON pack for agents and scripts; follow repoPath links into Andromeda for full CWPs
3After changing mesh-bridge MESH URLs or health paths, run npm run verify:super-centaur-pack in p31ca
